sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the 5 th respondent is in judicial custody.
2. Learned Government Pleader, on instructions, submits that the 5th respondent has vacated from the petitioner's house.
3. The 5th respondent, though served with notice through special messenger, has not entered appearance.

In view of the submission above, the writ petition is disposed of by making the interim order dated 10.11.2025 absolute.
